notablePrerequisites:
The total mana value of Dragons you control is at least 13.

description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Earthquake Dragon by paying at most {1}{G}.
Brinelin and Gwenna trigger.
Resolve the Brinelin trigger, returning Sailors' Bane from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Sailors' Bane by paying {U}{U}.
Brinelin and Gwenna trigger.
Resolve the Brinelin trigger, returning Earthquake Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.
